shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && printf '\\n--- catalog ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' app/catalog/page.tsx && printf '\\n--- home ---\\n' && sed -n '1,220p' app/page.tsx && printf '\\n--- all project files ---\\n' && rg --files | head -200"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/prefetching.md && printf '\\n--- linking nav ---\\n' && sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-getting-started/07-linking-and-navigating.md 2>/dev/null || true && printf '\\n--- link api location ---\\n' && rg --files node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app | rg 'link|page\\.md|cache' | head -80 && printf '\\n--- next config ---\\n' && cat next.config.ts && printf '\\n--- layout ---\\n' && cat app/layout.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,280p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/optimizing-prefetching.md && printf '\\n--- docs app link ---\\n' && sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/02-components/link.md && printf '\\n--- page searchParams ---\\n' && rg -n -C 5 \"searchParams.*Promise|use.*searchParams|prefetch\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/page.md | head -120 && printf '\\n--- nav guide ---\\n' && sed -n '1,160p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/04-linking-and-navigating.md"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js/partialPrefetching.md && printf '\\n--- use cache ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/01-directives/use-cache.md && printf '\\n--- cacheLife ---\\n' && sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/cacheLife.md && printf '\\n--- config cache components ---\\n' && sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js/cacheComponents.md"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- app/page.tsx lib/data.ts next.config.ts && git status --short'
